lines.rom: arati sri gaiya maiya ki arati harani visvadhaiya ki
arthakama saddharma pradayini avicala amala muktipadadayini sura manava saubhagyavidhayini pyari pujya namda chaiya ki
akhila visva pratipalini mata madhura amiya dugdhanna pradata roga soka samkata paritrata bhavasagara hita drrha naiya ki
ayu oja arogyavikasini dukha dainya daridrya vinasini susma saukhya samrddhi prakasini vimala viveka buddhi daiya ki
